name: Voice LLM (vLLM Qwen3-8B-AWQ)
purpose: the voice agent's fast LLM: vLLM Qwen/Qwen3-8B-AWQ (awq_marlin, hermes tool calls, 16k context, max 16 seqs, --gpu-memory-utilization 0.45), private on voice.network; its gateway offloads weights to host RAM after 300 s without API requests and wakes it on demand
installedBy: hosts/gpu-195/install.sh (rootless podman quadlet, user powos, linger on)
autosleep: gateway sleeps vLLM level 1 after five minutes without OpenAI API requests; next request wakes weights from host RAM
health: private on voice.network; public health and OpenAI API are via voice-llm-gateway :8100
vramNote: GPU0 is leased to Flash Next only while the voice gateway confirms vLLM is asleep; voice requests preempt dual-GPU Flash Next before waking
